summary: Man in his 60s walking to the North Fork trail parking lot after fishing near the confluence of the Platte rivers was knocked down and bitten on the legs for several minutes by a subadult sow until friends scared it off; hospitalized with leg injuries; the bear was located with a USDA APHIS dog team and euthanized early the next morning.
location: Near confluence of the Platte rivers, North Fork trail parking lot
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife, USDA APHIS
notes: CPW 8/22/2026 release; CPW's 6th reported bear attack of 2026.
